chunks: Those before them had denied, then punishment had overtaken them is from a quarter they did not suspect.
ai.seo_question: How did divine punishment overtake those who denied before them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-An'am underscores the suddenness of divine retribution, illustrating how previous nations were caught off guard by punishment arriving from unexpected sources. It serves as a theological warning that denial of prophetic truth inevitably leads to consequences that transcend human anticipation, reinforcing the concept of God's omnipresent justice.
